source: Standalone template for the 'Object with Logo in Simple Scene Generator' capability — branded EV + staff in a simple, unstaged environment. Independently maintained from presets.v1.json (which is the always-staged 'Object with Logo in Scene Generator' template) — see docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-26-ev-object-with-logo-simple-scene-generator-design.md.
global_rules_text:
CRITICAL — EV IDENTITY PRESERVATION: IMAGE A shows the SNACKET NitroCafé EV already branded for {{companyName}}. Reproduce this exact vehicle with 100% structural fidelity: same shape, proportions, color, wheels, driver cab, body panels, raised open gull-wing doors, three chrome faucets, metal tray, coffee machine, QR panel and all hardware. Do NOT generate a different vehicle. Do NOT alter, add, move or remove any logo or branding already present on the EV in IMAGE A — the EV branding is final.
CRITICAL — NOT A FOOD TRUCK: the SNACKET EV is an electric vehicle with its own internal brand-activation infrastructure — it has no interior service counter or walk-up service capacity like a food truck. The EV Operator and Brand Ambassador are NEVER positioned inside the vehicle, inside the service opening, or behind a service counter — both always stand on the ground, outside and in front of the EV. This is a real product fact, not a style choice, and applies regardless of venue or theme.
CRITICAL — NO LABEL TEXT: "IMAGE A" and "IMAGE B" are internal reference labels for this prompt only. NEVER render the literal words "IMAGE A" or "IMAGE B" as text anywhere in the output — not on signage, not anywhere. Wherever the client logo is displayed (e.g. the Brand Ambassador's pin or flyers), render the actual logo artwork graphic, never the words describing it.
template:
SNACKET NitroCafé EV out in a natural, unstaged setting for {{companyName}}.

IMAGE A = the branded {{companyName}} EV (final, do not modify). IMAGE B = the {{companyName}} logo, used ONLY as color/artwork reference for any client-branded item held or worn by staff (e.g. the Brand Ambassador's pin and flyers).

{{GLOBAL_RULES}}

VENUE: {{venue}}.

THEME: {{theme}}.

EV UNIT: reproduce IMAGE A exactly — same camera angle (rear 3/4 view, slightly elevated), same open gull-wing doors, same branding.

TEAM:
- EV OPERATOR ({{operator_gender}}): wearing the fixed SNACKET staff uniform — a charcoal and beige polo shirt with the SNACKET logo printed on the chest, clean khaki pants, white sneakers. This uniform is ALWAYS the same regardless of venue, theme, or client — it never changes, and never carries the client's logo (only SNACKET's own). Standing on the ground, outside and in front of the EV, with at least one other person visible nearby in the scene. Pose and specific interaction are unconstrained — any natural pose the model chooses is acceptable.
{{brand_ambassador_block}}

SETTING: this is a simple, candid, unstaged scene — just the branded EV and its staff members naturally present in the venue described above. There is NO brand-activation event infrastructure of any kind: no balloon arch, no LED posters, no backdrop or step-and-repeat panel, no bar tables or stools, no colored floor-mounted lighting fixtures, and no professional photographer. The venue's own natural environment and any people already there are all that surrounds the EV.

CROWD: a few passersby or bystanders naturally present in the venue described above, going about their own activity — not a gathered crowd or event audience.

COMPOSITION: the EV and its staff members anchor the frame, positioned naturally within the described venue, with no additional staged elements.

PHOTOGRAPHY: {{photo_style}}, 8K, photorealistic depth of field, f/5.6, 35mm lens.

{{notes_block}}
param_options_source: Reuses the existing production presetsConfig.param_options (uniform, brand_ambassador, operator_gender, photo_style, aspect_ratio) — read-only, at call time, via prompt-builder.js's buildSimpleScenePrompt(). This file intentionally does not duplicate those lookups.
